title: Outdoor Grilled Chinese Pork Belly Skewers
description: Tender and adventurous Chinese dish featuring pork belly slices, grilled to perfection on a robata-grill with a citrusy flavor, paleo-friendly and spherified for a unique twist.
instructions: Preheat the robata-grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Whisk together orange juice, soy sauce, honey, garlic, and ginger in a large bowl.
Add the sliced pork belly to the marinade and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Thread the marinated pork belly onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with sesame oil and season with salt and black pepper.
Grill the skewers on the robata-grill for 10-12 minutes, or until the pork is tender and slightly charred.
Mix the sodium alginate with water to create a spherification bath.
Dip the grilled pork belly pieces into the spherification bath to create a unique and adventurous texture.
